place_info.title: Brown's BBQ
place_info.address: 1901 S Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78704, United States

reviews.snippet:
Best brisket we've had in Austin so far. Even better than Terry Black's, Loro (so dry), and a couple others we tried but can't even recall. Moist, tender, great smoke ring, best flavor, and so affordable!
My photo of the one on regular white bread is the SMALL brisket sandwich!!!
Seriously, if you're looking for incredible smoked brisket, this is where you find it.

reviews.snippet: First of all the guy inside who I’m assuming is the owner was a really nice guy with great customer service. I only tried the pork ribs and the beef ribs and both were great. I especially loved how he did the beef ribs and they were smaller room less fatty than what I’m used to. He did them a different way but I really like them a lot.  The pork ribs were good too, and I’m not a big sauce guy, but the two sauces he gave me were very good.  It’s a food trailer parked outside a bar. And I guess if you pay $15 and drink inside the bar on Sundays, you get free barbecue or something like that. Which seems like a pretty good deal to me. I’m definitely going back. I’m glad I decided to stop.

reviews.snippet: Outdoor trailer barbecue place. Good bar right across the way. Mac & cheese absolutely delicious. Brisket sausage sandwich was made. Two barbecue sauces one mustard based one sweeter, red or sauce. Go for the sweeter Ritter sauce.

reviews.snippet:
Delicious food and great service. Basically no line which was shocking.

According to someone who’s been in Austin 30+ years, this food was way better and cheaper than some of the other well known (and Michelin starred) BBQ places. Will definitely be back!

reviews.snippet: Went here when they just open for a quick bite before heading to the airport.  Need last bbq before heading out.  Simply delicious and juicy and the meats are just simple tasty and tender and clever thing you could think of.  It’s a food truck parks right infront of the bar so you ordered, get your foods and go inside and get drinks and enjoys the foods.  The service is great & friendly and turnaround is quick too.  The vibe is just simple great and easy going plus the bar is more of a garage type & simple with great music.  Love it.
